deans-office.name: Dean's Office
deans-office.description: The office where the final project report must be submitted. The professor waits in the seminar room next door.
deans-office.image_prompt: university dean office, stacks of papers, formal desk, fantasy style

seminar-room.name: Seminar Room
seminar-room.description: A small room used for project defenses. Professor Riddle sits here, ready to pass judgment.
seminar-room.image_prompt: university seminar room, projection screen, professor at table, fantasy style

project-report.name: Final Project Report
project-report.description: The completed project report that must be submitted to Professor Riddle to pass the course.
project-report.image_prompt: thick bound thesis report, university stamp, fantasy academic style

hero.name: Alden the Student
hero.description: A student on the verge of completing his academic journey. All that remains is submitting the project report.
hero.image_prompt: young student holding thesis, relieved expression, fantasy university

professor.name: Professor Riddle
professor.description: The final gatekeeper. He awaits the project report in the seminar room and will pass judgment on the student's entire semester.
professor.image_prompt: elderly professor at seminar desk, academic robes, stern expression, fantasy style

dialogues.before_talk: Riddle: Ah, you again. You have the report? This had better be worth my time.
dialogues.after_talk: Riddle: Go fetch the report. I do not accept empty hands.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Riddle: ... Surprisingly adequate. You pass. Now get out of my sight.
dialogues.hostile: Riddle: Unacceptable! This student has wasted my time. Remove them!
